input.body:
John,

Before I call 8D done I went back through everything on the unit against the actual records instead of going off what's been said in passing, and I want to give you the straight story.

Where it stands:
- The make-ready turn itself is complete and was cleared for leasing back on 5/29. In-house repairs (drywall, kitchen faucet, bedroom/living paint) are done, Victor Rios cleaned the carpet and fixed the seam (5/23), Isela did the deep clean (5/24), and the QC punch list from Jaime's 5/26 walk — hallway baseboard scuff and the bedroom outlet cover — was signed off.
- The refrigerator swap took the priority morning slot on 6/25 (it was the critical path for the lease signing). The paired Rio Bend run finished the same day, so the fridge should be in — but it was never written to a ticket, so I want to physically confirm it's installed and running before we call it done.

What's still open:
- The kitchen garbage disposal (Linear OPS-227). On my 6/22 Las Palmas run I found it seized — the flywheel's frozen and the motor won't reset — so it's a full replacement, not a repair. I routed it to you for parts approval before swapping it, and it's been sitting since 6/22. That's the one real thing keeping 8D from being genuinely move-in ready.

What it'll take to finish:
1. Your approval to buy the replacement disposal unit. As soon as I have that, I'll pick it up, swap it, and verify operation the same day.
2. A quick confirm that the 6/25 fridge is in and running — I'll knock that out on the same trip.
3. Then I'll flip the make-ready record to Ready and we can give Brooke/leasing the green light.

Heads up — I corrected the Airtable make-ready record, which was still showing 8D as "Ready." It's back to In Progress until the disposal is done so nobody schedules a move-in on a unit without a working disposal. Given there's a lease signing tied to 8D, if you can approve the disposal this week I can have it closed out within a day.

Thanks,
James
